visualRuntimeAcceptance.note: This record proves source, CI/build, independent diff review, coordinator authorization, merge, and merged-main source readback. It does not claim post-merge physical-device or screenshot-based visual acceptance.

coordinator.initialBlockReason: Required status check Pandora coordinator / integration was expected.

durableLessons: When the ordinary GitHub integration lacks write scope, use the already-governed Supabase Vault-backed Github_supabase broker rather than exposing or copying credentials.
A protected merge must satisfy the trusted Pandora coordinator check and merge fence; do not bypass repository rules.
For a light-to-dark token inversion, dark feature panels whose background used the old ink token must be explicitly remapped to a dark surface token or they will invert to light.
Removing decorative brand images should preserve semantic navigation and functional icons, and merged-main source readback should confirm no target-file image references remain.
Exact-source CI and diff review prove source/build integrity but do not substitute for post-merge visual runtime acceptance on the target device.

Treat PR #697's pure-black side-panel behavior as a preserved visual invariant: shared Pandora side panel #000000, PLP navigation side panel #000000, chat canvas #000000; later brand-alignment work must not regress it.
PR #699's black PLP content-page interpretation was incorrect and is superseded by PR #701. Do not infer that matching Pandora's black profile mark means making PLP content pages black.
